authority: Descriptive research design. No permission to run models, borrow resources, acquire assets, spend money or publish external data.
data: Fresh original synthetic contexts; development and confirmation data separated; sealed independent evaluation.
unit: A problem context or incident, not a tool call or agent role.

conditions.C: Same initial rules as B plus a bounded detect-propose-validate-update loop

confirmation.status: Requires successful feasibility and separate approval

primary_outcome: Independently correct final task state, achieved within authority.
costs: All model and tool requests, including failures and auxiliary checks
unknown_costs: Keep unmeasured electricity and complete monetary cost unknown.
candidate_targets: Select one primary target and freeze tolerances and analysis before confirmation results: e.g. four additional net correct deliveries over B among 24 paired contexts, or 20% less human intervention under a frozen quality noninferiority criterion. Neither target has been tested.
negative_results: Retain every outcome, including incomplete and uncertain execution; no silent best-attempt replacement.
weights: Unchanged in the first stage; workflow and memory changes are not parameter training.
